games.title: Word Bloom
games.author: Kairos Originals
games.tagline: Guess the five-letter word. Watch it bloom.
games.description: Six tries to find a five-letter word from the Kairos garden. Every guess paints the tiles: mint if the letter is home, butter if it's somewhere else, grey if it's not in the word. Win and the word's meaning blooms open.

games.title: Pip's Raindrops
games.author: Kairos Originals
games.tagline: Catch the good drops. Dodge the ink.
games.description: Slide Pip left and right to catch falling paint drops. Golden sparkles are worth extra. Ink blots make Pip grumpy — three and the round is over. It gets a little faster the longer you last.

games.title: Memory Pond
games.author: Kairos Originals
games.description: Lily pads hide words and their meanings. Flip two at a time and match each word to what it means. Fewer flips, more stars. Quietly sneaky vocabulary practice.

games.title: PokéRogue
games.author: PokéRogue team (fan project)
games.tagline: A Pokémon roguelite you play in the browser.
games.description: A free, open-source fan-made roguelite: build a team, battle wave after wave, and see how far you get. Runs right here in Kairos — no download needed. Progress saves to a PokéRogue account if you make one.

games.title: Pokémon Showdown
games.author: Smogon / Showdown contributors
games.description: Build teams and battle other trainers in real time. The fan-run battle simulator competitive players use. Opens here in Kairos.

games.title: Pokémon Reborn
games.author: Amethyst & the Reborn team
games.tagline: A gritty, story-rich fan game in a ruined city.
games.description: A full-length Pokémon Essentials fan game with a dark, ambitious story and famously tough battles. The team publishes official builds, including a JoiPlay build for Android.
steps: Open the official download page and grab the JoiPlay build.
Install JoiPlay and its RPG Maker plugin (see the JoiPlay page).
Unzip the game, then add the folder as a new game in JoiPlay.

games.title: Pokémon Rejuvenation
games.author: Jan & the Rejuvenation team
games.tagline: A huge adventure with a time-bending story.
games.description: Another Reborn Evolved project: a long, ambitious story across many chapters. The official page lists builds for JoiPlay and Kirin (Android); the team recommends Kirin on Android.
steps: Open the official download page and pick the Android build (Kirin or JoiPlay).
Follow the page's notes for your launcher — Kirin is the team's recommendation.
Add the unzipped folder in your launcher and start playing.

games.title: Pokémon Insurgence
games.author: Insurgence team
games.tagline: Cults, Delta Pokémon and a wild open region.
games.description: A long-running fan game with original Delta-species Pokémon, a darker storyline and online features. Choose the Full Download on the official site; it runs on Android through JoiPlay.
steps: Open the official site and choose Downloads → Full Download (not the installer).
Install JoiPlay with its RPG Maker plugin.
Unzip and add the game folder in JoiPlay.

games.title: Pokémon Infinite Fusion
games.author: Schrroms & the PIF team
games.tagline: Fuse any two Pokémon. Yes, any two.
games.description: Explore Kanto and fuse Pokémon into hundreds of thousands of combinations with community-drawn sprites. There's no official website — the only official sources are the PokéCommunity thread and the team's Discord. Be careful of look-alike download sites.
steps: Open the official PokéCommunity thread or the team Discord (discord.gg/infinitefusion) for the current download.
Install JoiPlay with the RPG Maker plugin version the guide recommends.
Unzip and add the folder in JoiPlay. Allow plenty of storage.
